newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Endesa to pay gross dividend of 280 pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Endesa to pay gross dividend of 280 pta.

text.p: Spain's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad Endesa said on Tuesday it will pay a total gross dividend of 280 pesetas, up 50.5 percent from previous year's dividend of 186 pesetas.
If the dividend is approved by the shareholders meeting on June 17 Endesa will pay a final gross dividend of 180 pesetas, which will add to the 100 interim dividend already paid in January 1997.
Endesa added that it expects its dividend to grow in the next years.
Endesa said Jose Damien Bogas Galvez has been appointed as director general.
